title: Persistent specimens
kicker: Roster and summoning · summon and fusion
hook: Every demon is a **specimen** — its own level, gear, and history — not a stack of identical copies.

blindSpots.meaning: One individual demon in your roster. Two Peashooter-line demons are still two specimens.
Player words for the same roster beings. You collect creatures; the ones you summon and bind are demons.
Another specimen of a species you already have — fuel for fusion, not trash to delete on sight.
They stay in your save across sessions and bank across worlds with who you are.

alsoTrue: The full multi-tab creature sheet is still WIP — the roster already shows level, gear, and history.

sections.title: What it is
paras: Identity, level, gear, traits, element, rarity, variant, and history live on the specimen.
Duplicates are not dust — they feed star merges, recipes, and trait inheritance in fusion.

cards.name: Inspect
cards.body: Open Creatures and read who you have.

cards.name: Bind
cards.body: Put demons on pacts so they will deploy — see [pacts and loyalty](pacts-loyalty).

cards.name: Field
cards.body: Bound specimens deploy to lawn; spare ones can go on expeditions.

cards.name: Fuse
cards.body: Spend duplicates and [essence](essence) in the Fusion lab.

sections.title: Where specimens come from
paras: Wild joins and (later) capture are other intakes — gacha is one path, never the only one.
diagram: altar / wild join / capture  ->  specimen on roster

doSteps: Pick one specimen and notice it has its own level and identity.
If you own a duplicate, treat it as fusion fuel — do not assume it is worthless.
doNote: Stop when “stack of copies” no longer fits. Next: [summoning altar](summoning-altar) or [pacts](pacts-loyalty).

mixUps.q: Can I merge two identical names into one stack?
mixUps.a: No. They stay individuals until you fuse them on purpose.

mixUps.q: Is a specimen the same as a species?
mixUps.a: Species is the kind. Specimen is one living instance of that kind.

mixUps.q: Do specimens wipe on a new world?
mixUps.a: No. Roster banks with who you are — see [New world](new-world-prestige).
Roster is Shipped; the finished multi-tab sheet is WIP.
